samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse Detection Module</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PULSE_START">State indicating the start of a pulse.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PULSE_END">State indicating the end of a pulse.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[2:0]">Register to store the current state.</reg>
        <wire id="next_state" width_description="[2:0]">Wire to store the next state.</wire>
        <always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = PULSE_START;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                PULSE_START: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = PULSE_END;
                    else
                        next_state = PULSE_START;
                end
                PULSE_END: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = PULSE_START;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        end
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n)
                state <= IDLE;
            else
                state <= next_state;
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Sequential logic for pulse detection.</implementation>
    <task id="reset_task">
        <description>Task to reset the state register.</description>
        <sequence>
            <assign id="state" value="IDLE" />
        </sequence>
    </task>
    <task id="update_state_task">
        <description>Task to update the state register based on the next state.</description>
        <sequence>
            <assign id="state" value="next_state" />
        </sequence>
    </task>
</module>
